activate.title: Activate AI
activate.subtitle: Let your own computer recognise your plants.
activate.how: Recognition runs on your computer (NVIDIA card), not on our servers. You download a ready-to-run folder, launch it, and confirm the connection. No Docker, nothing to install.
activate.step1Hint: A ready-to-run folder with everything inside. It's large (~6 GB), but only once.
activate.step2Hint: Right-click the downloaded file → "Extract All". You get a "verdure-ai" folder.
activate.step3Hint: In the "verdure-ai" folder, right-click "start.ps1" → "Run with PowerShell". Leave the window open.
activate.step4Hint: A page opens on its own to check it really is your computer — nothing to copy. It then shows up below.
activate.altHint: To download far less (but with an automatic install step): a small .exe that assembles the folder on its own.
activate.error: That didn't work. Please try again.

pair.title: Connect this computer
pair.prompt: A computer is asking to enable AI on your account:
pair.warning: Only confirm if this code is showing on YOUR computer. This program will be able to process your plant photos.
pair.approved: All set! Your computer is connected. You can head back to the app.
pair.notFound: No valid connection request for this code. The program makes a new one on its own — try again with the new link.
pair.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
